domain: paper SUT domain (pde_sciml: DeepXDE -- THIRD-PARTY PINN library, in-the-wild)
sut_family: deepxde.icbc.boundary_conditions.BC.normal_derivative (Neumann/Robin flux residual) -- anchored on 1D Poisson PINN with a Neumann (flux) boundary
cat: conservation / flux (Neumann no-flux == mass/energy conservation boundary; Noether)
confounder_check: Only 4 commits between v1.3.0 and v1.3.1 (9d270a6 FAQ doc, fab492b issue config, 4bac5eb THE fix, fb01d68 version bump); 4bac5eb is the ONLY functional change to BC code -> FIRED->HELD attributable to exactly this fix.
mr_used: conservation/flux block: a Neumann BC n.grad u = g is the discrete statement of a prescribed boundary flux (g=0 == zero-flux mass-conservation boundary d/dt int_Omega u = 0). PINN oracle: the flux residual r_flux = n.grad u - g must be COMPUTABLE/finite at boundary collocation points.
fired_type: CRASH (TypeError: Interval.boundary_normal() missing 1 required positional argument: '_') -- the Neumann/Robin flux residual cannot be formed at all, so the conservation/flux MR is unenforceable.
verified: SELF-RUN pip: pre 1.3.0 FIRED (NeumannBC.error -> TypeError missing arg '_'; RobinBC.error same TypeError) / post 1.3.1 HELD (NeumannBC flux residual n.grad u - g = -3.0, finite). u=x => du/dx=1, n=+1 at x=1, g=2(x+1)=4 => residual 1-4=-3.0.
upstream: DeepXDE git commit 4bac5eb (root cause: BC.normal_derivative called self.boundary_normal(X,beg,end) with 3 args, but the npfunc_range_autocache wrapper requires 4 args (X,beg,end,_); fix adds the 4th arg None).
note: THIRD-PARTY in-the-wild bug in the most widely used PINN library (DeepXDE), NOT paper-authored, NOT a mutant. Strengthens the pde_sciml conservation block which previously had only a self-built PINN mutant (M_TIME_NEG, paper T2). Both NeumannBC AND RobinBC fire on pre (matches fix title). HONEST LEVEL: crash-type (the flux/conservation boundary residual is uncomputable in v1.3.0), reproduced via the exact buggy call path (BC.error -> normal_derivative -> boundary_normal) on PyTorch CPU backend with a tiny net and no training. Library default backend is tensorflow.compat.v1; reproduced on the pytorch backend (set DDEBACKEND=pytorch). Repro: results/deepxde_repro/repro_deepxde_neumann.py.
